title: Islam
summary: Islam denotes the religion; the community is Muslims, the civilization Islamic civilization, the countries Islamic countries. The adjective Islamic is used for things relating to Islam as religion, culture, or group of countries (Islamic law, Islamic pottery); Muslim is used when the noun refers to persons (Muslim women, Muslim converts). Obsolete Mohammedan/Mohammedanism forms were changed in 1964.
validation_rules: `Islam` denotes the religion; the community of believers is `Muslims`, the culture/civilization is `Islamic civilization`, and the countries sharing the religion are `Islamic countries`. (H 1680 Background)
Do not use the obsolete forms `Mohammedan` / `Mohammedanism` (changed in LCSH in 1964). (H 1680 Background)

Use the adjective `Islamic` for "of, relating to, or characteristic of Islam" as religion, cultural system, civilization, or group of nations, e.g. `Islamic sects`, `Islamic literature`, `Islamic law`, `Islamic pottery`, `Islamic countries`, `Islamic shrines`. (H 1680 sec. 1, 3)

Use the adjective `Muslim` when the noun modified refers to persons (believers), e.g. `Muslim converts`, `Muslim saints`, `Muslim women`; `Muslim` may also be used elsewhere where warranted by predominant usage. (H 1680 sec. 2)
The alternative adjective form is a reference only, e.g. `Islamic converts` is a UF to `Muslim converts`; `Muslim shrines` is a UF to `Islamic shrines`. (H 1680 sec. 3)

sections.heading: 1. Islamic.
sections.text: Use Islamic as an adjective indicating "of, relating to, or characteristic of Islam" as a religion, cultural system, or civilization, as well as the group of national political units that share the Islamic religion, for example, Islamic sects; Islamic literature; Islamic law; Islamic pottery; Islamic countries.

sections.heading: 2. Muslim.
sections.text: Use Muslim as an adjective whenever the noun modified refers to persons, the believers of Islam, for example, Muslim converts; Muslim saints; Muslim women. The adjective Muslim may also be used in other instances when this is warranted by predominant usage.

sections.heading: 3. References.
sections.text:
When establishing headings qualified by the terms Islamic or Muslim, add 450 fields with the alternative forms. Examples:

```
150 ## $a Muslim converts
450 ## $a Islamic converts

150 ## $a Islamic shrines
450 ## $a Muslim shrines
```
